HERO_WORKSHOP.NoHdc: {name} has no Hero Designer data yet. Upload an HDC file with the system's Upload button first.
HERO_WORKSHOP.NotOwner: You need owner permission on {name} to edit it.
HERO_WORKSHOP.NotAFamily: This folder isn't a Hero Designer list or framework. Right-click an item in it to edit that item.
HERO_WORKSHOP.TokenActor: Hero Workshop edits the base actor. Open {name} from the Actors sidebar to edit it.
HERO_WORKSHOP.ApplyFailed: Hero Workshop could not update {name}. The actor was not changed; see the console for details.
HERO_WORKSHOP.ItemNotEditable: Hero Workshop cannot edit {name} (no Hero Designer data for this item type).
HERO_WORKSHOP.RaceLibraryHint: Races and their listed characteristics, used to derive each character's characteristic maxima.
HERO_WORKSHOP.NoSection: Hero Workshop can't add {name} to a character.
HERO_WORKSHOP.OpenItemsInWorkshopHint: Opening an item in the Items sidebar or a compendium edits it in Hero Workshop instead of showing hero6e's item sheet (which is still in the item's right-click menu). Items on characters, and items you can't edit, still open hero6e's sheet.
HERO_WORKSHOP.RepairImportsHint: When hero6e imports an HDC or HDP, link Combat Skill Levels to the attacks they name, comma-separate adjustment targets, and make other fixes hero6e needs. The build is not changed.
HERO_WORKSHOP.ImportRepaired: Hero Workshop repaired {changes} thing(s) in {name} for hero6e; {unresolved} couldn't be repaired automatically. Details are in the console (F12).
